sloka: तत्राकरोन्महायुद्धं राजा दशरथ स्तदा ।असुरैश्च महाबाहुः शस्त्रैश्च शकलीकृतः ॥२-९-१५॥
transliteration: tatrākaronmahāyuddhaṁ rājā daśaratha stadā ।asuraiśca mahābāhuḥ śastraiśca śakalīkṛtaḥ ॥2-9-15॥

translations.english: There in that great battle the mightyarmed king Dasaratha lay wounded with weapons (used) by the asuras.
